summary: Read-only source review completed for all 12 assigned routes, plus account-deletion, mailbox-data and billing dialogs. 13 actionable findings: 9 P2 and 4 P3; no confirmed P1 was established in this source-only pass. Primary launch concerns are subscription mutation locking, scoped feedback state, connection recovery, entitlement-derived mailbox capacity, truthful historical/billing copy, and destructive-dialog focus. Existing tests/stories were inspected for states, not run; rendered accessibility and fixture execution are independently covered by the parent. No repository source was modified, and no live APIs, payments, Gmail or account writes were performed.

findings.state: Known entitlement tier while billing is disabled or unavailable
findings.title: Mailbox limit disappears when the optional billing read fails

evidence.detail: The mailbox allowance is derived only from billing.data?.tier, with null on BILLING_DISABLED/read failure, although useTier supplies the known auth entitlement immediately below.
MailboxesCard receives null inboxLimit when billing has no data.
atLimit is false for a null limit, so Add Gmail remains enabled at line 71 and disconnected reactivation loses its plan-limit guard at line 124.
The API independently rejects connection when connected >= the actual tier limit, creating a predictable refused path.

findings.recommendation: Use the auth entitlement from useTier for mailbox capacity, as Brief settings and AccountMenu already do. Reserve the billing read for subscription facts.
findings.verification: Source-confirmed; not runtime-tested. Mock Free with one active mailbox and billing 503 BILLING_DISABLED/read failure, and assert Add Gmail plus disconnected reactivation are limit-disabled while existing-mailbox reauthorization remains available.
findings.launchImpact: A billing-disabled launch currently offers plan-ineligible connection actions and removes the explanation/upgrade path.

findings.state: Pause request in flight inside cancellation dialog
findings.title: Pause and cancellation can be submitted concurrently

evidence.detail: The primary cancellation action is marked busy only by isCanceling; isPausing does not disable it or lock the sheet.
The Pause button correctly disables for either mutation, showing the asymmetric lock.
Sheet busy/dismissal protection is derived from primary.busyLabel; therefore an in-flight pause still permits cancel, Escape, scrim and Keep current plan.
Pause runs a separate mutation from cancellation, without a parent guard against cancellation during that request.

findings.recommendation: Apply one busy state for isPausing || isCanceling to the primary action and the sheet dismissal lifecycle. Keep the correct pending label for the action that actually started.
findings.verification: Source-confirmed; deferred-provider outcome not exercised. Use a mocked unresolved pause promise and assert cancellation and all dismiss paths stay unavailable until the pause settles.
findings.launchImpact: Conflicting subscription instructions can be sent from the same review dialog; resolve before allowing public billing changes.

findings.state: Historical edition selected after feedback saves, or while a feedback request is unresolved
findings.title: Feedback selection and success receipt carry across Brief editions

evidence.detail: selected and savedNow are local state; the only reset effect at line 66 depends on initialRating, not referenceId/surface. Successful mutation sets savedNow=true at line 72.
InlineFeedback is reused without key={brief.id} when the historical switcher changes its referenceId, unlike the explicitly keyed NoiseSection above.
Existing tests cover initial value, successful save and failure, but no reference-change case.

findings.recommendation: Reset selection, receipt and mutation state when the observation identity changes; prevent a late response for the prior reference from marking the new edition saved. A keyed Brief feedback instance can provide the immediate scope boundary.
findings.verification: Source-confirmed; not executed. Save Useful on an edition whose initialRating is null, switch to another null-rated edition and assert no selection or saved receipt carries over. Repeat with the first request resolving after the switch.
findings.launchImpact: Users are shown feedback as saved for an edition they have not rated, weakening the trustworthiness of observation feedback.

findings.state: First cleanup review receives CurrentMailboxGuard 409 after the connection changes
findings.title: Cleanup onboarding retries a connection conflict instead of reconciling it

evidence.detail: Every read error, including ApiError scope 409s, becomes an EmptyState with Try again invoking the same firstTriage.refetch at line 95.
The first-triage endpoint is explicitly protected by CurrentMailboxGuard.
The sibling protection review already handles mailbox scope conflicts with Refresh connection and resetMailboxScopedCache, which updates me and re-derives onboarding.
The remaining corner escape writes skipped:true, so it abandons onboarding rather than repairs the connection state.

findings.recommendation: Apply the protection review's designed connection-conflict recovery to the first cleanup review and use ErrorState for failed reads.
findings.verification: Source-confirmed; not executed. Return SELECT_MAILBOX/NO_ACTIVE_MAILBOX for the first cleanup read while cached me still has an active mailbox, and assert Refresh connection re-derives the appropriate step without writing skipped:true.
findings.launchImpact: A stale connection can strand new users in a retry loop unless they skip onboarding.

findings.state: Viewing a historical Brief containing Noise senders
findings.title: Historical Noise rows and archive preview still say yesterday

evidence.detail: The edition-aware dayWord reaches NoiseSection, but line 743 renders NoiseRow without passing it.
NoiseRow always formats the frozen count as messages yesterday.
The shared preview always describes its scope as not only yesterday's mail, even when opened from a historical edition.
The historical-language regression test checks heading and screen-help only; it does not cover rows or the archive sheet.

findings.recommendation: Thread the edition's covered-date wording through every frozen-count label. Describe the action's wider scope as all inbox mail now versus email in this Brief, so the preview is truthful for every edition.
findings.verification: Source-confirmed; not executed. Select a historical edition with Noise, assert its rows use that covered date, then open the archive preview and assert no stale yesterday qualifier remains.
findings.launchImpact: Date labels contradict the selected edition at the mail-changing decision point.

findings.state: Cold subscription read failure without a local pending-payment record
findings.title: A failed billing read asserts that no charge or plan change occurred

evidence.detail: BillingErrorState says No charge or plan change was made. A failed read cannot establish the transaction or webhook outcome, including activity on another device.
The schema-unknown sibling correctly scopes its assurance to Loading this page made no charge or plan change.

findings.recommendation: Scope the reassurance to the read operation, or state that billing details could not be confirmed. Preserve the distinction between an unavailable read and an actual transaction outcome.
findings.verification: Source-confirmed copy issue; not runtime-tested. Render the cold read-failure fixture and assert it does not claim an account-wide no-charge outcome.
findings.launchImpact: The error surface can mislead users who are checking whether a recent payment succeeded.

findings.state: Free tier's read-only rule catalog fails to load
findings.title: Read-only Autopilot tells users to retry but offers no retry control

evidence.detail: The rules.isError branch renders Couldn't load your preset rules / Try again in a moment, with no action or refetch handler.
The hook returns the normal query result, including refetch; the surface could expose a real recovery action.

findings.recommendation: Use the standard recoverable ErrorState and wire Retry to rules.refetch. Keep the read-only preview and upgrade messaging independent from catalog recovery.
findings.verification: Source-confirmed; not executed. Reject the catalog GET once, then succeed; assert a visible retry control recovers the rule list without upgrading or navigating away.
findings.launchImpact: A failed first impression of paid value has no in-product recovery path.

findings.state: Past-due payment method cannot be changed through the self-service provider path
findings.title: Support-assisted payment copy promises access beyond the enforced dunning deadline

evidence.detail: For showSupportPath plus isPastDue the card states Your plan stays active while we sort this out with you, without a time or entitlement boundary.
past_due gets an entitlement deadline derived from the period end plus the dunning window.
The sweep changes expired past_due subscriptions to canceled once entitlement_ends_at passes; support correspondence does not suspend that guard.

findings.recommendation: Use neutral support-next-step copy and, when known, the actual access deadline. Do not imply contacting support guarantees continued paid access.
findings.verification: Source-confirmed policy/copy mismatch; no provider calls made. Render the Razorpay/unsupported past_due variant and assert its assurance respects the recorded entitlement deadline or makes no indefinite access promise.
findings.launchImpact: Customers can rely on an access promise that the billing service does not enforce.

findings.state: Keyboard focus in the typed account-deletion confirmation field
findings.title: Account deletion removes the visible keyboard focus ring

evidence.detail: The typed-confirm input sets inline outline:none. Its boxShadow at line 239 changes only for an exact phrase match, not focus.
The shared :focus-visible rule supplies the normal outline; an inline outline:none overrides it.

findings.recommendation: Remove the inline outline reset or add a dedicated visible focus style independent of phrase validity.
findings.verification: Source-confirmed style override; rendered keyboard verification remains needed because the parent reports the modal Storybook fixture lacks a QueryClient provider. Tab into the field with an incomplete phrase and confirm a visible ring in both themes.
findings.launchImpact: The keyboard focus location is hidden during a consequential destructive confirmation.

findings.state: First review completed or no candidates found
findings.title: Continue to Senders actually opens Overview or the retained billing destination

evidence.detail: The completion button reads Continue to Senders.
The protection completion button repeats Continue to Senders; the unknown-split body at line 427 also promises that destination.
Successful completion executes router.replace(returnTo ?? '/home'), not /senders.

findings.recommendation: Use a destination-neutral completion label such as Open workspace, or derive the destination label from the same routing decision. Update both completion panels and their matching copy/tests.
findings.verification: Source-confirmed; not executed. Complete each first-review goal with no returnTo and with a validated billing intent, checking that the CTA truth matches the resulting destination.
findings.launchImpact: Small but visible mismatch at the handoff into the product.

findings.state: Mailbox has no saved quiet-hours configuration
findings.title: Default quiet-hours draft is labelled Saved before any save exists

evidence.detail: A null server config is replaced by DEFAULT_DRAFT and useBrowserDefault=true.
The default draft is also used as baseline; browser timezone initialization updates both baseline and draft, so dirty stays false.
Any nondirty form displays Saved, including the null-config state.
The Unconfigured story explicitly supplies a ready state with config:null.

findings.recommendation: Show Off/unconfigured, or omit the receipt until an actual persisted configuration exists. Keep the disabled-by-default behavior.
findings.verification: Source-confirmed; not rendered by this reviewer. Inspect Unconfigured and save a mocked first configuration; Saved should appear only for the latter.
findings.launchImpact: Minor persistence-status overclaim for first-time Quiet users.

findings.state: Preset rule read fails or reaches its polling cap
findings.title: Preset selection still claims preparation after the status read has stopped

evidence.detail: Rule polling stops immediately on query error and after RULES_SEED_MAX_POLLS at line 110.
Every not-loading/unseeded state still renders Your suggestions are still being prepared, without distinguishing a failed read or capped wait.

findings.recommendation: Distinguish a loading/waiting response from inability to confirm preparation. Keep the valid ability to save selections, and expose recovery when the catalog read failed.
findings.verification: Source-confirmed; not executed. Exercise a cold rule-read failure and repeated empty 200 responses to the cap, confirming neither makes an unverified preparation promise.
findings.launchImpact: Minor recovery/truth issue; setup itself remains continuable.

findings.state: Review-only preset with intent=enable and default canRunUnattended=true
findings.title: Review-only activation component can display an automatic-action choice

evidence.detail: reviewOnly is computed, but offersChoice at line 139 does not include !reviewOnly.
The displayed Act now option is accompanied at line 242 by Acts on matching email now and as it arrives, contradicting the review-only subtitle and note.
The fixture uses AUTO_ARCHIVE_LOW_ENGAGEMENT, a review-only preset, and EnableWithWatchFirst at line 75 omits canRunUnattended, taking its true default.
The current production caller correctly passes false for review-only presets, so the live route is presently protected from this contradictory choice.

findings.recommendation: Enforce the review-only invariant inside ActivateRuleModal as well as its caller. Correct the story to represent the current preset behavior, with a separate non-review-only fixture for the Watch/Act choice.
findings.verification: Parent observed the contradiction in mobile Storybook; this reviewer independently confirmed source. Add an isolated component case that cannot render Act now for either review-only preset, regardless of omitted canRunUnattended.
findings.launchImpact: Component/story contract inconsistency; not evidence that the current production caller executes review-only matches automatically.
